Rachel,

Appreciate the quick acknowledgement. A few clarifications from our security team:

1) The SOC2 letter is required; redaction of customer names is fine but we need scope and opinion verbatim.
2) KMS diagram: please include where keys are stored and whether CMKs are customer-managed or provider-managed. High level only is fine.
3) For any artifacts that include logs or configuration exports, please provide an excerpt (1–2 pages) rather than full logs.

We prefer transfer via the Drive link in the questionnaire, but we can accept an SFTP/secure-upload URL if you provide host and creds (or signed URL). Download-only Drive link is acceptable.

Also: please include a one-line statement of data residency per environment (e.g., Hosted-US: us-west-2, Dedicated-EU: eu-west-1).

Thanks — we look forward to the staged bundle.

Daniel
